parameters.name: AutoBuild
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to trigger image building when source code is committed. Valid values:

*   `true`: triggers image building when source code is committed.
*   `false`: does not trigger image building when source code is committed.

parameters.name: CodeRepoName
parameters.description: The name of the source code repository.

parameters.name: CodeRepoNamespaceName
parameters.description: The namespace to which the source code repository belongs.

parameters.name: CodeRepoType
parameters.description: The type of the source code hosting platform. Valid values: `GITHUB`, `GITLAB`, `GITEE`, `CODE`, and `CODEUP`.

parameters.name: DisableCacheBuild
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to disable building caches. Valid values:

*   `true`: disables building caches.
*   `false`: enables building caches.

parameters.name: OverseaBuild
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Build With Servers Deployed Outside Chinese Mainland. Valid values:

*   `true`: enables Build With Servers Deployed Outside Chinese Mainland.
*   `false`: does not enable Build With Servers Deployed Outside Chinese Mainland.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the image repository.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-repo-source-code-repo --instance-id cri-shac42yvqzvq0000 --repo-id crr-gzsrlevmvoaq0000 --code-repo-type GITHUB --code-repo-namespace-name namespace --code-repo-name repo --auto-build true --oversea-build false --disable-cache-build false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateRepoSourceCodeRepo --region cn-hangzhou --AutoBuild true --CodeRepoNamespaceName namespace --DisableCacheBuild false --InstanceId 'cri-shac42yvqzvq0000' --CodeRepoName repo --CodeRepoType GITHUB --OverseaBuild false --RepoId 'crr-gzsrlevmvoaq0000'
